description: This file implements the ProvisioningEntriesWritePlatformService interface using JPA repository methods. It manages provisioning entries including creation, re-creation, journal entry handling, and generating provisioning data for loan products. The class interacts with repositories, handles exceptions, and processes JSON commands to facilitate provisioning logic in a financial application.

classes.name: ProvisioningEntriesWritePlatformServiceJpaRepositoryImpl
classes.description: Implementation of provisioning service that handles creation, re-creation, and journal entry processing for provisioning entries, integrating with various repositories and services.

methods.name: createProvisioningJournalEntries
methods.description: Creates journal entries related to a specific provisioning entry, reverting existing journal entries if necessary.

methods.name: revertAndAddJournalEntries
methods.description: Handles reverting previous journal entries and adding new ones based on provisioning entry data.

methods.name: validateForCreateJournalEntry
methods.description: Validates that journal entries can be created based on existing and requested provisioning entry dates.

methods.name: isJournalEntriesRequired
methods.description: Checks if create journal entries parameter is specified in the JSON command.

methods.name: parseDate
methods.description: Extracts the date parameter from the JSON command.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Creates new provisioning entries based on JSON command input, after validation.

methods.name: createProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Creates a provisioning entry for a specific date, generating provisioning data and optionally adding journal entries.

methods.name: reCreateProvisioningEntries
methods.description: Re-creates provisioning entries by clearing existing provisioning data and regenerating.

methods.name: generateLoanProvisioningEntry
methods.description: Generates provisioning entries for loan products for a specific parent provisioning entry and date.
